items.prompt:
The periodic table is arranged by increasing
A) atomic number
B) color
C) weight in grams
D) price

steps: Elements are ordered by atomic number.

items.prompt:
Elements in the same column are a
A) group
B) row only
C) molecule
D) mixture

steps: A column is called a group.

items.prompt:
An element's chemical properties are mainly determined by its
A) outer electrons
B) color
C) name
D) location in the room

Elements in the same group have
A) the same number of outer electrons and similar properties
B) totally different properties
C) no electrons
D) the same color only
items.answer: A) the same number of outer electrons and similar properties

steps: Same outer electrons give similar properties.

items.prompt:
Metals are generally found on the ____ of the periodic table.
A) left
B) right
C) bottom only
D) center only

steps: Metals are on the left side.

items.prompt:
A far-left metal with one outer electron tends to
A) lose that electron easily and be very reactive
B) gain many electrons
C) never react
D) become a nonmetal
items.answer: A) lose that electron easily and be very reactive

steps: Such metals lose their outer electron readily.

items.prompt:
An element in the same group as chlorine would likely
A) behave similarly, tending to gain one electron
B) behave oppositely
C) never react
D) become a metal
items.answer: A) behave similarly, tending to gain one electron

steps: Same group means similar electron-gaining behavior.

items.prompt:
The periodic table works as a model because
A) its organization by electron patterns lets you predict element behavior
B) it lists prices
C) it is colorful
D) it has no pattern
items.answer: A) its organization by electron patterns lets you predict element behavior
